assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
A 48-hour Holter monitor is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes.
The service is medically necessary for this beneficiary under the current benefit plan.
The patient has atherosclerotic heart disease.
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The patient experiences dizziness and giddiness.
The Holter monitor is associated with CPT code 93226.
The claim was denied for the 48-hour Holter monitoring study, CPT code 93226.
The denial is based on Reason Code PR-204.
The service is not covered under the patient's current benefit plan.
No payment will be issued for this specific procedure.
The patient has the right to appeal this determination.
The appeal must be initiated by submitting a written request detailing the medical necessity and coverage justification within the timeframe specified in the provider agreement.
Supporting documentation must be included to facilitate a timely review of the case.
